subject: Pipeline snag — request for sandbox supplement and 2-week pilot extension
messages:
From: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@archival.ai>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pipeline snag — request for sandbox supplement and 2-week pilot extension

Hi Dylan,

Quick note from the Archival AI engineering team: we hit a blocker this morning during connector work. An upstream schema change in our partner API caused a cascade of test failures in ingestion; engineers are working through it but estimate a 10–12 day delay to get back to the milestone we had planned.

We’re in the middle of the pilot and the team is now at risk of running out of sandbox capacity before we can validate ingestion corrections. We’d like to request a modest sandbox supplement (roughly 200k tokens equivalent) and a two-week extension on the pilot window so we can finish the integration and keep the demo on track.

I attached a short build_log.txt and an updated demo_plan.pdf that shows the revised timeline and a clear rollback path. We’re asking for an expedited decision since this materially affects our rollout date.

Proposed ask:
- Sandbox top-up: 200k token equivalent
- Pilot extension: +14 days

If there’s a preferred format for the credit notice or an internal approval memo you need from our side, we can provide it. Appreciate any help you and your team can offer to keep momentum.

Thanks,
Lina Gomez
Head of AI, Archival AI
Lina.Gomez@archival.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments:
- build_log.txt (text)
- demo_plan.pdf (PDF)

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@archival.ai>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pipeline snag — request for sandbox supplement and 2-week pilot extension

Hi Lina — thanks for flagging and for the clear timeline in the demo plan. Sorry to hear about the schema issue; that kind of cascade is always frustrating.

I’ve looped in Kimberly (Commercial Ops) and Ben (Account Exec) so they can review the ask and expedite an approval path. Can you confirm two quick items while we triage: 1) whether the 200k tokens are estimated for the remainder of the pilot only (yes/no), and 2) do you want the extension to land immediately or start after the current milestone date? A one-sentence confirmation will help speed things through approvals.

I’ll push for a decision this week and will share an internal approval note if we can greenlight the top-up.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Dylan.Brooks@redwood.com

--

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Apr 2028 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Pipeline snag — request for sandbox supplement and 2-week pilot extension

Thanks for pulling this in, Dylan. Reviewed Lina’s note and the attached demo plan. Given the deal stage and the clear mitigation plan, I’m prepared to approve a conditional supplement.

Approval (conditional):
- Sandbox top-up: 200k token equivalent credited to Archival AI’s sandbox environment immediately.
- Pilot extension: +14 days added to the existing trial window.
- Conditions: Archival AI to submit an updated mutual action plan (MAP) within 3 business days with revised milestones; we will require a short post-extension check-in call to confirm integration health before any further supplement.

I’ve drafted a short approval memo (approval_memo.pdf) for records. Ben, please confirm you’ve communicated the conditions to the customer and that we’ll log the credit in the billing ledger under RDW-1729. Kimberly.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Commercial Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

Attachments:
- approval_memo.pdf (PDF)

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 04 Apr 2028 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Pipeline snag — request for sandbox supplement and 2-week pilot extension

Hi Lina — good news: we can provide the top-up and the extension, on the conditions Kimberly outlined below. Summary of what’s approved and next steps: 

Approved:
- Sandbox top-up: 200k token equivalent (credited to your sandbox account).
- Pilot extension: +14 days on the current pilot window.

Conditions / Next steps:
1) Please upload the updated mutual action plan (MAP) to the shared Drive folder within 3 business days: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/archival-pilot
2) We’ll schedule a 30-minute check-in call after the extension period to verify integration stability.
3) Credits will be recorded under deal RDW-1729; Ben will confirm ledger entry.

I attached a short credits_notice.pdf for your records; it includes the top-up amount and the revised expiry date. Let me know if you need the supplement split across environments or staged differently — we can accommodate.

Happy to hop on a quick call if that accelerates things.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Dylan.Brooks@redwood.com
